title: Senior DV Protocol Checklist
description: An evidence-oriented checklist for finding corner cases and signing off the selected protocol revision and interface configuration.

items.description: Stimulus: legal traffic is constrained by revision, interface width, address map, optional properties, and configured resource limits; negative protocol injection is a separate mode with expected checker outcomes.
Checking: monitors reconstruct only accepted transfers; independent predictors and scoreboards retain phase, channel, ID, route, beat, data, and response ownership.
Stability and legality: zero-delay, consecutive, single-cycle, bursty, and long stalls pass protocol safety properties, including payload stability and known controls.
Coverage: legal, illegal, and ignore bins are generated from configuration; every planned legal hit is correlated with passing checker and scoreboard evidence.
Formal: reset and environment assumptions, covers, proof bounds, abstractions, vacuity results, and over-constraint review are documented.
Progress: fairness, timeouts, and bounded service are checked only against documented product contracts and assumptions, separately from universal protocol safety.
Signoff: each requirement links to stimulus, checker/assertion, coverage, regression artifact, owner, configuration, open-bug status, waiver rationale, and reviewer.
